_note: Drafted from facts already on this site (the profile, the journeys and the booking flow). Pricing and inclusions are deliberately not stated as figures or lists: both are settled with Nandana on WhatsApp once he has seen the journey, which is how this business actually works.

items.question: How do I book a tour?
items.answer: There is no online booking form and no payment page. You send an enquiry — either through the custom-tour planner or straight from any WhatsApp button on the site — and Nandana replies personally to agree the details. WhatsApp is how this business has taken bookings for years.

items.question: Do I need to check whether my dates are available?
items.answer: No. Every journey is staffed by the company's own certified guides rather than bought from a third party, so there is no availability calendar to check — any date can be arranged.

items.question: Are these private tours, or will I join a group?
items.answer: Private. You travel with your own guide and your own vehicle; you are never added to a coach with strangers. The custom-tour planner takes parties of one to twelve travellers.

items.question: Who will guide me?
items.answer: Nandana Hewagamage, or one of the company's own guides. Nandana has guided in Sri Lanka for over 20 years, is certified by the Sri Lanka Tourism Board, and specialises in birding, wildlife, wildlife photography, trekking, and culture and history.

items.question: Can I change my plans after I have sent an enquiry?
items.answer: Yes. Every enquiry gets a short reference like NW-7K3QD. Open it again at the “my trip” link, sign in with the email address you used, and amend it — the previous version is kept, so nothing is lost.

items.question: What is included in the price, and what is not?
items.answer: There is no fixed inclusions list, because there is no fixed journey. What a journey covers is worked out for the dates you travel: the season and the weather decide which parks, trains and boats are worth the day, and what is happening culturally while you are here — a perahera, a poya day, a festival — changes what is worth building the week around. Nandana goes through it with you on WhatsApp and tells you exactly what your journey covers before anything is agreed.

items.question: How and when do I pay?
items.answer: We do not publish a price, because there is nothing to price until we have seen your journey. Once we know your dates, your party and the route, Nandana looks it over and gives you the figure himself, along with what it covers. It is all settled directly with him on WhatsApp — there is no payment page on this site.
